article.title: Quiz: guess the idiom's meaning
article.description: Quiz format: 'What does "spill the beans" mean? a) Cook dinner  b) Reveal a secret  c) Make a mistake  d) Waste money' Answer: b) Reveal a secret. Teaching point: this idiom is commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information.
article.content: Quiz format: 'What does "spill the beans" mean? a) Cook dinner  b) Reveal a secret  c) Make a mistake  d) Waste money' Answer: b) Reveal a secret. Teaching point: this idiom is commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information.

generated.caption:
Ever accidentally revealed a secret you shouldn't have? 🤫 That's exactly what it means to "spill the beans"!

This informal idiom means to reveal confidential information, whether accidentally or on purpose. For example: "Please don't spill the beans about the surprise party!"

Save this idiom for later! Follow @englishvault for daily English tips.
generated.script: Kabhi suna hai 'spill the beans'? Iska matlab kya hai, log confuse ho jaate hain ismein! Dekho, 'spill the beans' ka matlab hai to reveal a secret. Ye idiom hum tab use karte hain jab koi galti se ya jaanboojh ke koi confidential information share kar deta hai. Basically, kisi raaz ko khol dena. Ab samajh aaya? 'Spill the beans' matlab koi secret reveal karna, koi raaz khol dena. Comment mein batao aapko ye pata tha ya nahi! Aur aise hi interesting English tips ke liye follow karo The English Vault.

slides.body: The idiom 'spill the beans' means to reveal a secret. It's commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information. So, if you 'spill the beans,' you're letting out information that was meant to be kept private, often before it was intended to be shared.
